usedFor: TidyCal holds bookings and Memory stores key-value data, so “When a booking is cancelled” can write a record through “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a booking is cancelled” in TidyCal, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: Cancelled bookings are kept as stored values you can look up later by key.

watchOut: Every TidyCal trigger here is polling, so “Memory” is written after a scheduled check.
